events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Seventy-five years young and still rocking! We're celebrating the one and only Chrissie Hynde today. What's your ultimate Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad for it
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo banger?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in 1975, four years after the album's initial release.

angles.name: Imagine the Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' first captivated the UK as a single. Its message resonates as strongly today as ever.

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple released the very first iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the days of the original iPod? Today marks 25 years since Apple dropped this game-changer, putting a thousand songs in your pocket and changing music forever.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: A Timeless Voice
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Ministry of Silly Walks and Wisdom
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, the brilliantly funny John Cleese turns 87 today! What's your favourite iconic moment from the comedy legend?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Fifty-Eight Years of White
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed their sprawling and iconic 'White Album' on the world. A masterpiece of diverse sounds. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: The Showman's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the extraordinary Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting remain unmatched. Forever a legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Soulful Revolution
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution. Which track from this classic album still resonates with you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: Peace and Music Forever
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon today, whose message of peace and incredible music continue to live on.
